carts_owner_check.name: carts_owner_check
carts_owner_check.value: "carts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "carts"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL

banners_schedule_check.name: banners_schedule_check
banners_schedule_check.value: "banners"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "banners"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "banners"."ends_at" > "banners"."starts_at"

orders_amounts_check.name: orders_amounts_check
orders_amounts_check.value:
"orders"."subtotal" >= 0 AND "orders"."discount_total" >= 0 AND "orders"."shipping_fee" >= 0
        AND "orders"."gift_wrap_fee" >= 0 AND "orders"."total" >= 0 AND "orders"."amount_paid" >= 0
        AND "orders"."amount_refunded" >= 0 AND "orders"."deposit_required" >= 0

shipping_rates_bounds_check.name: shipping_rates_bounds_check
shipping_rates_bounds_check.value:
"shipping_rates"."fee" >= 0 AND "shipping_rates"."min_weight_g" >= 0 AND ("shipping_rates"."max_weight_g" IS NULL OR "shipping_rates"."max_weight_g" > "shipping_rates"."min_weight_g")
        AND "shipping_rates"."eta_min_days" >= 0 AND "shipping_rates"."eta_max_days" >= "shipping_rates"."eta_min_days"
